title: Notion inference stream field compatibility matrix
privacy_boundary: This artifact contains only field names, structural observations, counts, timing positions, non-content metrics, and compatibility judgments. Prompts, response prose, account/workspace/thread/message identifiers, record values, cookies, headers, and credentials are excluded.
evidence_convention: NDJSON indexes are zero-based. HAR evidence names only sanitized files and logical locations; no private values are reproduced.

duplicate_observation.basis: Sanitized request body and decoded response NDJSON are byte-equivalent according to the derived protocol audit.

source_overlap.overlap_basis: Sanitized transcript type order and string lengths, NDJSON event order and outcome, and terminal usage/limit integers for the successful transaction.
source_overlap.hook_only_transaction: Target 1 is a distinct short success with no matching HAR body.

confirmed_behavior: Buffers through patch-sync and verifies complete reconstructed state.
Retimes terminal Notion input/cache usage into message_start and re-emits cumulative input/cache/output usage at message_delta for SDK 0.121.0 accumulator correction.
Emits explicit nulls for SDK 0.121.0 message/delta container and stop details, text citations, cache counts, and extended usage fields that the Notion captures do not supply.
Marks end_turn as a synthetic adapter stop policy.
Does not project auto-load control steps as Anthropic tool calls.
Omits finishedAt, server timing, context/input limits, retry history, and failover metadata from the SSE projection.
Converts responses only; it does not reconstruct partial request history or map Notion thread identity to a provider continuation handle.
Fails closed for incomplete, misordered, non-text (including compaction), state-mismatched, or in-stream error inputs; an error is rejected before synthetic success SSE rendering.
Rejects captured application-level quota outcomes before synthetic success rendering; the target error status and taxonomy remain adapter policy.
Declares the conversion non-lossless and unsupported for reasoning, native tools, compaction, top-level stream errors, and cancellation.

anthropic_typescript_sdk_note.accumulator_behavior: MessageStream overwrites usage values from message_start when corresponding terminal MessageDeltaUsage fields are non-null.
anthropic_typescript_sdk_note.compatibility_effect: A live projection may use placeholder/inaccurate usage in message_start and achieve accurate final accumulated Notion-reported usage with a terminal message_delta correction. This does not make the initial event accurate and does not verify provider/tokenizer/cache semantics.
anthropic_typescript_sdk_note.model_limit: The final Notion model alias has no equivalent terminal correction path; placing it accurately in message_start still requires buffering and replay.

adapter_conclusions: A low-latency text-only projection is possible from the initial agent-inference block and x-operation content extensions.
A projection with the observed final model alias and accurate Notion-reported input/cache metadata in its first downstream event must buffer the complete Notion stream and replay it.

For Anthropic TypeScript SDK 0.121.0 clients, a live projection can correct cumulative input/cache/output usage in terminal MessageDeltaUsage and achieve accurate final accumulated Notion-reported usage; message_start remains placeholder/inaccurate and the final model alias cannot be corrected.
outputTokens can be emitted terminally as a cumulative count; no per-delta usage exists.
Successful completion is observable, but no captured field identifies the model's stop cause. Any downstream stop_reason or finish_reason is adapter policy.
Auto-load agent-tool-result steps are not evidence of model tool calls and must not be converted into native tool-use events.

Native Anthropic compaction request controls, content blocks, deltas, stop reason, and usage iterations are absent from the five successful streams and two quota outcomes and cannot be reconstructed from completion or token telemetry; broader Notion behavior is untested.
Any non-null encrypted_content received from a genuine Anthropic compaction flow must be persisted and round-tripped verbatim.
Projecting the captured partial continuation or adding compaction from these artifacts requires an adapter-owned canonical ledger; threadId alone is insufficient for that conversion.

Two live HTTP-200 application-level quota failures must be rejected as downstream errors without synthetic success; their Anthropic subtype, downstream HTTP status, retryability, and partial-stream policy remain adapter decisions.
Top-level stream-error, non-200 transport-failure, and abort branches are present in browser code but remain unvalidated by live captures.
